name: GLP-1 Nutrition Tracker
oneLiner: A one-afternoon daily tracker for meals, water, eating windows and weekly trends. Local-only. Not medical advice.

screenshots.alt: The daily dashboard: hero ring, meal list, water tracker and eating window

whatIBuilt: A daily nutrition tracker built on 2026-04-15 in one sitting: a hero ring for the day's target, quick meal logging, a water tracker, an eating-window view and a weekly trend. Everything stays in the browser; there is no account and no server. It is a personal tool and not medical advice.
whatILearned: How fast a well-scoped personal tool can be when the stack is familiar: a working app in an afternoon, because the components and patterns were already ones the agent had built for me before. Reuse compounds.
builtWithAI: Built with Claude Code from a sketch of the four screens.
